ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, if $\angle AOC = 110^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle B$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: Since circle $O$ is inscribed in $\triangle ABC$ and $\angle AOC=110^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle OAC+\angle OCA=180^\circ-\angle AOC=70^\circ$,\\
and $\angle OAC+\angle OCA=\frac{1}{2}(\angle BAC+\angle ACB)$,\\
therefore $\angle BAC+\angle ACB=140^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle B=180^\circ-(\angle BAC+\angle ACB)=180^\circ-140^\circ=\boxed{40^\circ}$.
